//: The per-figure paint texture of a token Chog (hat, outfit): canvas pixels at full size, origin top-left. tools/blender/chog_wear.py writes UVs into it; client/src/three/characters/chogPaint.ts paints it. A slot's D area holds the front (decal) faces, its P area every other face, wrapped every `wrap` px with `guard` px of pattern either side; one swatch row of 32 px squares per slot. Pixels per unit (k) are the same both ways, and a row is (ytop - y) * k below the area's top.
